messages:
Iris Tan: quick thread on the compact usage table: where should invoice download and token detail live for org vs project scope? figma: https://redwood.app/fig/1888888888.png
Marco Diaz: two camps: visible per-row CTA (super discoverable) vs clean header bulk export (less noise). accountants usually want the per-row. :ledger:
Sasha Ivanov: accessibility note: per-row CTA must include full accessible name with scope & period. toolbar needs explicit language like "Export invoices (selected)" vs "Export invoices (filtered)" so SR users know what they'll get.
Hannah Lee: perf caveat: per-row DOM nodes in the virtualized list can be costly. prefer render-on-focus/hover or event delegation so we don't bloat the DOM.
Iris Tan: proposal: hover/focus-reveal inline icon (always keyboard tabbable though) + kebab menu with actions (Download PDF, View tokens) + sticky selection toolbar when rows selected. hybrid aims for discoverability + low density.
Marco Diaz: agree hybrid. small visible icon for single-download, kebab for secondary actions, toolbar for bulk. microcopy: inline -> "Download invoice (PDF)"; kebab item -> "View token breakdown"; toolbar -> "Export invoices (selected)". add sr-only full context.
Sasha Ivanov: ARIA guidance: inline button aria-label example: ```html
<button aria-label="Download invoice for Acme Co 1 Project: Payments 1 May 2026 (PDF)">⬇️</button>
``` and include visually-hidden text node with invoice id. announce token panels with role=region and a heading.
Hannah Lee: implementation notes: 1) delegate click on list root (data-row-id) to avoid many listeners; 2) only render visible inline icons; 3) lazy-load token breakdown on expand using requestIdleCallback for better initial paint.
Iris Tan: UX question: token breakdown inline collapse vs right flyout? inline collapse is friendlier for keyboard + SR, flyout keeps vertical rhythm. thoughts?
Marco Diaz: lean inline collapse for accessibility. If we need compactness, collapse should have max-height + overflow auto and keyboard focus trap avoided.
Sasha Ivanov: agree inline collapse. ensure open/close announced via aria-live and focus moves into the expanded content when opened via keyboard.
ExperimentBot: /ab-test create export_affordance_variant variants=[A_inline_focus,B_kebab_primary,C_hybrid] duration=7d metrics=[download_rate,keyboard_download_pct,support_tickets] url=https://redwood.app/experiments/exp_900
Hannah Lee: acceptance criteria for hybrid prototype: 1) single-invoice download reachable via keyboard without mouse; 2) screen reader reads scope & period for each download; 3) virtualization perf <=10% regression at 95th percentile; 4) 5-user discoverability test with non-power users.
Iris Tan: I'll update frames with hover/focus reveal + inline collapse and post by EOD. tagging @Sasha for final aria text and @Hannah for perf checklist.
Marco Diaz: small copy tweak: visible label should be short ("Download (PDF)") and full context in sr-only copy. keeps density.
Sasha Ivanov: noted. I'll draft SR snippets and a short screen-reader test script for usability sessions.
Hannah Lee: I'll spike delegated-handler branch and add an automated keyboard e2e that verifies tab-to-download and download analytics fire.
Iris Tan: thanks team 1 once frames are in we'll pick a variant and kick off the AB test. :sparkles:
